author: gyalchester
body:
I want to ask if a /block or /ignore could be added to Avicus. 

If you use /block it would stop the person you have chosen to PM your say your name in chat.

Format of /block
/block [player] [time]

For example:
/block Junr 5 

PS: it does not need to be exactly like i explained above.

Thank you,
- Incorrupt
